title: Verbs from words
goal: Make verbs from nouns and adjectives, and read a story with all of this unit's verbs.

intro.text: Four suffixes make verbs from nouns and adjectives: `-lA` (*duzlamak*, to salt), `-lAş` (*dostlaşmak*, to make friends), `-lAn` (*gaharlanmak*, to get angry) and `-Al` (*azalmak*, to decrease). Many of them then take a causative with *-t*: *azaltmak*, to reduce.

vocab.en: to make friends, to become friends
to decrease, to go down (azaltmak: to reduce)
to increase, to grow in number
to grow up (ulaltmak: to bring up, to raise)

exercises.question: *Az* means **little, few**. Which verb means **to decrease**?

why.1: For **become less** or **become more**, the suffix is `-Al`: *azalmak*, *köpelmek*.

exercises.explain: *az* + *-al* (become less) + *-t* (make) + *-dy* (past): made it less, reduced it.

exercises.en: Merdan and I became friends at school.

accept: The exam is [coming up|approaching|getting near|drawing near]
The test is [getting closer|coming up|approaching|getting near]

exercises.label: *dostlaşmak* (to make friends), past: I made friends, you made friends…
exercises.explain: *dost* + *-laş* makes the verb; then the past *-dy* and its endings, with back vowels.

exercises.question: Which means **he grew up in a village**?

exercises.explain: *az* + *-al*: to become less. A plural thing often takes a singular verb.

exercises.prompt: Don't get your new clothes dirty!

exercises.question: *Gaharlanmak* is **to get angry**. What is *gaharlandyrmak*?
options: to be angry with each other

why.1: `-dYr` adds someone who makes it happen: to make someone angry.
why.2: **Each other** would be the reciprocal `-(Y)ş`, not `-dYr`.

exercises.prompt: We have to reduce the price.

reject.why: With `-mAlY`, say who has to: *Biz bahany azaltmaly*.
*Azalmak* is **to go down** by itself. Making it go down is the causative: *azaltmaly*.

exercises.translation: Kerim is getting married next month. The wedding day is getting closer, and there is more and more to do at home. Last week the two families met for the first time. Kerim introduced Bahar's parents to his own parents. They talked for a long time and agreed about the wedding. Now everyone is getting ready. Kerim's mother had a new dress made. His father had the car washed. Kerim had his hair cut and had photos taken with Bahar. His friends are helping each other too. Only his mother is worried: “There are so many more guests now. Will there be enough food for everyone?” Kerim makes his mother laugh: “Mum, if you cook the pilaf, there'll be enough for everyone!”

questions.q: Who introduced the two families to each other?
questions.explain: *Kerim Baharyň ene-atasyny öz ene-atasy bilen tanyşdyrdy.*

questions.q: Who made the mother's new dress?
options: someone else: she had it made
questions.explain: *tikdirdi*: the causative, she had it made.
*Myhmanlar gaty köpeldi*: the guests have become many more.
